# contrast.group_collection.group_dataset_from_contrasts { #fmrimod.contrast.group_collection.group_dataset_from_contrasts }

```python
group_dataset_from_contrasts(contrasts, *, covariates=None)
```

Lower one first-level contrast per subject into a ``GroupDataset``.

`fmrimod.fmri_group_lm` accepts the same mapping directly; call
this when you need the `GroupDataset` itself (e.g. to attach
covariates or pick a different group reducer).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| contrasts  | Mapping\[str, ContrastResult \| Sequence\[ContrastResult\]\] | ``{subject_id: ContrastResult}`` from first-level ``fit.contrast(...)`` calls, all for the same contrast and with standard errors. A one-element sequence per subject is also accepted. | _required_ |
| covariates | pd.DataFrame \| None                                         | Optional subject-level table with a ``subject`` column matching the mapping keys; stored as the dataset's ``col_data``.                                                                 | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                        |
|--------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | GroupDataset | Estimates and standard errors as group assays, with the authored contrast intent kept as metadata. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

::

    per_subject = {sub: fit.contrast("face - house") for sub, fit in fits.items()}
    gd = group_dataset_from_contrasts(per_subject, covariates=ages)
    result = fm.fmri_group_lm(gd, formula="~ age")
